test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Cease
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Begin.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym of the word** "cease"** is **"begin"**. 
 
• **Cease **means** to stop or come to an end**.
 
 
• For example, "The rain **ceased **after an hour."
 
 
 
• **Begin** means** to start or commence**.
 
 
• For example, "Let's **begin **the meeting now." 
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is** Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Other options: **
 
• **Terminate:** This is a synonym of "cease" and means to end or bring to a close.
 
 
• For example, "The contract was **terminated **due to breach of agreement." 
 
 
 
• **Quit: **This is a synonym of "cease" and means to stop or resign from something.
 
 
• For example, "He decided to **quit **his job and start his own business." 
 
 
 
• **Halt: **This is also a synonym of "cease" and means to stop or pause.
 
 
• For example, "The train **halted **at the station for a few minutes."
